# ReconGraph

ReconGraph is a deterministic, offline-first finance-reconciliation prototype built for Razorpay AI Buildathon Track 4.

## Important evidence boundary

All displayed finance records are synthetic. Benchmark results are measured against a separately stored held-out fixture. The app has no production Razorpay account, customer data, external model, or money-moving capability.
